from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out-4/play/users/u051/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):\n    background = max(set(value for row in grid for value in row), key=lambda value: sum(cell == value for row in grid for cell in row))\n    counts = {}\n    for row in grid:\n        in_run = False\n        for value in row + [background]:\n            if value != background and not in_run:\n                counts[value] = counts.get(value, 0) + 1\n                in_run = True\n            elif value == background:\n                in_run = False\n    cells = [color for color in (3, 2) for _ in range(counts.get(color, 0))]\n    cells = (cells + [0] * 6)[:6]\n    return [cells[:3], cells[3:]]\n'''
p=base/'task-9ebf6ad9.py'; p.write_text(source)
ns={}; exec(source,ns)
in1=[[8]*19 for _ in range(10)]
for r,a,b,c in [(1,0,6,3),(1,12,16,2),(3,2,10,3),(5,14,18,3),(6,5,8,3)]: in1[r][a:b]=[c]*(b-a)
in2=[[5]*10 for _ in range(10)]
for r,a,b,c in [(1,0,4,3),(3,1,3,2),(4,6,9,2),(7,4,8,3)]: in2[r][a:b]=[c]*(b-a)
out1=[[3,3,3],[3,2,0]]; out2=[[3,3,2],[2,0,0]]
print(ns['transform'](in1), ns['transform'](in1)==out1)
print(ns['transform'](in2), ns['transform'](in2)==out2)
test=[[0]*10 for _ in range(15)]
for r,a,b,c in [(1,1,5,3),(3,2,8,2),(7,5,9,3),(9,5,7,2),(11,1,3,3),(13,4,8,2)]: test[r][a:b]=[c]*(b-a)
